generatedProse.practice-connection: From here, delivering well is something you practise in every presentation you give. Each time you read a brief, build a structure, or cut a crowded slide to one clear figure, these skills are at work. They travel beyond your studies too: research talks, team briefings and job interviews all reward the presenter who prepares for the task and avoids the common errors.
